name: Plaster
overview: Scripture uses plaster as a symbol of restoration and protection, particularly in the context of cleansing and healing. In Leviticus 14, plastering a house after removing stones and scraping it signifies the process of making the house ceremonially clean from plague, demonstrating God's provision for renewal. Deuteronomy 27 also mentions plastering stones as part of a covenantal act, emphasizing the importance of setting apart and preserving what God has given. Additionally, Daniel 5 depicts plaster as the surface on which divine judgment is written, highlighting its role as a witness to God's sovereign communication.
